title: ship-cli project configuration (ship.config.json)
description: Non-secret, repo-committed configuration for shipping a game project to distribution platforms. Secrets (Steam credentials, WeChat upload keys) are never stored here: they come from environment variables or user-level key files referenced by path.

schemaVersion.description: Config schema version. Only 1 is supported.

name.description: Optional human-readable project name used in output.

relativePath.description: Relative path, forward or back slashes, no leading slash, no '..' segments.

appId.description: Steam AppID of the base application.

contentRoot.description: Root directory of built content. Resolved against the config file location.

buildOutput.description: steamcmd BuildOutput directory (logs + chunk cache). Must NOT be inside contentRoot.

executable.description: Optional main executable relative to contentRoot, checked by 'steam test'.

steamcmdPath.description: Optional explicit steamcmd executable path. Env SHIP_STEAMCMD wins over this.

id.description: Depot ID. Convention: base app depots start at appId+1.

source.description: Directory inside contentRoot whose CONTENTS map to the depot root. Use "." for the whole contentRoot.

exclusions.description: FileExclusion glob patterns for this depot, e.g. *.pdb, *_BurstDebugInformation_DoNotShip*.

projectPath.description: Mini game project directory (contains game.json / game.js / project.config.json).

robot.description: miniprogram-ci robot slot (1-30). Different robots keep separate dev-version records in the MP backend.

privateKeyPath.description: Path to the code-upload private key file downloaded from the MP backend. Env SHIP_WX_PRIVATE_KEY / WX_UPLOAD_KEY wins over this. May contain '~'.

ignores.description: Glob rules passed directly to ci.Project and used by source-size estimation.

bigPackageSizeSupport.description: SDK preview-only option; does not alter upload limits.

limits.description: WeChat package size limits in bytes (1024-based M). Defaults follow official rules as of 2026-10; override only when WeChat changes them.
